title: Mind the Gap! Choice Independence in Using Multilingual LLMs for Persuasive Co-Writing Tasks in Different Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLM performance differences between a high-resource language (English) and a relatively lower-resource language (Spanish) using instruction following and paraphrasing datasets, and analyzing how this disparity impacts user reliance in a persuasive co-writing task.

Manipulating the order of language exposure (English-first vs. Spanish-first) during an AI-assisted writing task to measure whether users irrationally generalize the LLM's performance from one language to a subsequent, independent task in another language.

Conducting a charitable giving experiment to measure if participants adjust their donation amounts based on their belief that an advertisement was generated by an AI versus a human, including an analysis of how this aversion varies across gender and linguistic/cultural groups.
